title: Fest Night at Hostel 7
place: Hostel 7, an old engineering-college hostel on a hill outside Pune
occasion: the last night of the college fest, with the India-Pakistan match on TV
blurb: The pro-show is over, the match is on, the Maggi is boiling, and the warden has given up. By midnight, one of them won't be graduating.
